title: Card Balance
description:
[h2]Small, targeted card balance changes.[/h2]
Each change is a separate patch, listed here and in the Card Library.

[h3]Changes[/h3]
[list]
[*][b]Master Planner[/b]: costs 1 energy instead of 2, and 0 when upgraded.
[/list]

[h3]Good to know[/h3]
[list]
[*]Changes gameplay, so everyone in a multiplayer lobby needs the mod.
[*]Built for game version 0.111.0. A game update can break a patch; it then logs an error and leaves the card alone.
[*]No dependencies.
[/list]

Unofficial fan-made mod, not affiliated with Mega Crit.
changeNote: v1.0.0: First release. Master Planner costs 1 (0 upgraded). Split out of the old Seed Search & Tweaks mod.
